units: B. Kam. 27ᵃ באתרא דכ׳ לא קרו וכ׳ in a place where they distinguish between kadda a. ḥabitha (v. preced.).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a:9">B. Mets. 59ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>כמשלם שערי מכ׳ וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) when the barley is gone from the pitcher, strife knocks and enters; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 888:20">Yalk. Ps. 888</cite> <cite ref="K00111"><he>כַּדָּה</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Chullin 58b:1">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite> top <he>הני תמרי דכ׳</he> (Var. <he>דכרים</he>, v. <cite ref="K01123"><he>כְּרוּם</he></cite> ch.) dates kept in a vessel (which became worm-eaten); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="K00105"><he>כַּדִּין</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00719"><he>כַּדַּיָּא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 18:34">Targ. I Kings XVIII, 34</cite>.
Targ. Jud. VII, 20; a. e.—Trnsf. כַּדָּא a big figure, important personage.
<cite ref="Yevamot 70a:10">Yeb. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>בן בתי כ׳</he> my grandson, the big vessel (high-priest), opp. <cite ref="K00226"><he>כוזא</he></cite> the little jug (bastard).
